basic_details.short_information: KSCSTE-Srinivasa Ramanujan Institute for Basic Sciences (SRIBS), Kottayam, is engaging two Project Assistants under its K-STAR project, purely on a temporary, project-based basis for an initial period of one year, at a consolidated remuneration of ₹30,995/month. rows.details: KSCSTE-Srinivasa Ramanujan Institute for Basic Sciences (An Institution under Kerala State Council for Science, Technology & Environment)
Maximum 40 yrs, as on the closing date prescribed for receipt of application
Temporary and project-based, initially for one year

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: Srinivasa Ramanujan Institute for Basic Sciences (SRIBS) is a constituent of the Kerala State Council for Science, Technology and Environment (KSCSTE). It fosters fundamental research across disciplines including chemistry, biology, physics, mathematics and computer science. The institute is at Pi Hills, 8th Mile, Velloor P.O., Kottayam – 686501. The K-STAR project envisages the establishment and operationalisation of a Supercomputing Centre at SRIBS. Implementation involves administrative coordination, documentation, procurement-related activities, institutional correspondence and IT support. Because SRIBS is primarily a theoretical research institution, personnel are required to support scientific-administrative activities and the associated academic and institutional operations.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: 1st class B.Sc. in Computer Science or Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) from a recognized university, with 5 years of work experience in Industrial/Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations. Master's degree in Computer Applications (MCA) / M.Sc. in Computer Science. Experience related to administrative/financial/purchase in industrial/Academic/Government Institutions and Scientific Activities and Services. 5 years of work experience in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations. Teaching experience in academic/educational institutions is considered desirable. Proficiency in Government office software and office applications, along with skills in report preparation and official correspondence. A good typing speed and fluency in computer use. The maximum age limit is 40 yrs as on the closing date prescribed for receipt of application. The notice does not print a minimum age. Age relaxation for reserved categories is as per applicable Government norms and rules adopted by the Institute; the notice does not list the relaxation by category. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries a consolidated remuneration of ₹30,995/month. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances. The engagement is purely temporary and project-based, initially for a period of one year. The period may be extended, subject to satisfactory performance, continued project requirements, availability of funds and approval of the competent authority. Leave is governed by the applicable rules and regulations/policies of SRIBS, as amended from time to time. The engagement does not confer any right or claim for regular appointment in SRIBS or KSCSTE.

content_sections.heading: SRIBS Project Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Administrative and coordination support for implementation of the K-STAR project and establishment of the Supercomputing Centre. Preparation and maintenance of official files, correspondence, reports and project documentation. Handling e-Office files and Government office-related software and digital platforms, including WAMS/treasury systems where applicable. Assistance with procurement, tender documentation, purchase records, bill processing and project records. Coordination with Government departments, technical agencies, vendors, research institutions and stakeholders. Support for scientific programmes, meetings, workshops and institutional activities. Assistance in maintaining academic, scientific and institutional records and providing other administrative support assigned by SRIBS.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SRIBS Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Go to the official website of SRIBS, https://sribs.res.in , where the Google Form for this recruitment is provided. Submit the application online through that Google Form on or before 08.12.2026. For a telephonic enquiry, call 0481-2500200. Visit www.sribs.res.in regularly for further changes, if any. The notice does not name any documents to be attached.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises scrutiny of applications, followed by an interview and/or skill assessment, as deemed appropriate, by a duly constituted Selection Committee. Preference is given to candidates with relevant teaching experience in academic institutions, in view of the academic and theoretical research-oriented environment of SRIBS. The notice does not give an interview date or venue.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The decision of the Director, SRIBS on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications is final, and no enquiry or correspondence will be entertained from any individual. If the interview is not conducted on the specified day due to unforeseen reasons, it will be held on the next working day.
